name: Cantabria
summary: Two horizontal bands of white over red. The colours come from the maritime registration flag of Santander's ships.
origin: White and red were the colours of the port of Santander's maritime flag. They were adopted in the 1981 Statute of Autonomy; a version with the arms is also used.
facts: It is the same as Poland's flag in design.
clues: White over red, two bands, from a Spanish port.
Identical in design to a European country's flag.
